By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.
We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.
If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
## Job Description
**About IFS****Logistics**
IFS Logistics (built and launched as 7bridges, now part of IFS) is an AI-native enterprise logistics platform. We unify transport data, optimise carrier spend, and automate execution for enterprise shippers and logistics companies. We're a small, dedicated team inside IFS, reporting into the commercial organisation rather than central R&D. Pure SaaS, zero consultancy.
**The role**
This is not a traditional "add AI to an existing system" role. You will own the product surface of our audit product end to end — the checks that tell a customer a delivery was late or a carrier charged them incorrectly, the queue where those findings get reviewed and actioned, and the self-serve configuration that lets a customer build their own checks without us.
Audit & Visibility is becoming a standalone product. A staff engineer leads the squad and brings the backend depth; you bring the product surface. You will set the approach for it, partner directly with the squad's Product Lead on product, and be the second technical voice in the squad. You are also the day-to-day mentor for the Junior engineer joining alongside you — that is part of the job, not an extra.
Your depth is frontend and product engineering. Every engineer here is expected to be genuinely fullstack; the profile describes where your depth is, not a boundary you stay inside. You will write Django, design the API contract you consume, and reason about what BigQuery and dbt are doing underneath your screens.
**What you'll work on**
* The audit review queue at real scale — tens of thousands of findings per tenant, filtered, triaged, actioned and evidenced.
* Self-serve check configuration: customers building, previewing and versioning their own audit checks. "Customers configure and manage it, not IFS" is a product principle, not an aspiration.
* Explainability for incorrect-charge detection — why this charge was flagged, against which rate card, at which version — reproducible months later for a dispute.
* The Django endpoints, data contracts and pagination behaviour behind all of it.
* Where the agent sits in each of these flows: agentic audit creation, human review at minimal, meaningful points, and the guardrails that make that safe against a customer's freight spend.
## Qualifications
**What we're looking for**
* Around five to eight years building and shipping production software, with real depth in React, TypeScript, state and interaction design at scale.
* You have owned a product surface end to end including the ambiguity in it — you closed the open questions rather than waiting for someone to close them for you.
* Genuinely fullstack: you write the Python/Django side, you argue about the API contract, and you know when a client-side answer is the wrong answer.
* Strong on performance and scale in the interface: pagination, virtualisation, server-side filtering, and knowing which of those the data volume actually demands.
* You build human-in-the-loop and explainability interfaces and treat auditability as a feature, not logging.
* You raise the bar on other people's work. Review, pairing and direct feedback are things you do by default, and you are happy mentoring an engineer earlier in their career.
* AI-native in practice: Cursor and Claude daily, good at giving an agent the right context, better at spotting when its output is confidently wrong.
* You form and state a view. Ambiguity is the job, not a blocker.
**Nice to have**
* Design-system ownership, or working shoulder to shoulder with a designer on a complex data surface.
* Django REST, BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud, GCP.
* LLM agents, RAG or evals in production.
* Shipped an agent that does real work, like agentic audit or fulfilment-rule automation, and the instinct to build a simulation to prove the logic first.
* Logistics, supply chain, freight, or any finance-adjacent domain where being wrong costs money.
**Tech stack**
React, TypeScript · Python (Django REST) · BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud, Superset · Pub/Sub, Datastream · GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD · LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, evals · Cursor + Claude, Notion (SDD Central), Jira.
**What success looks like — first 6 months**
* You own the audit review and configuration surface end to end, and the open questions in it get closed by you.
* Self-serve check configuration is in production, with preview and versioning, and customers use it without us.
* The queue performs at the largest tenant's data volume, measured, not assumed.
* The Junior engineer in the squad is productive and shipping reviewed work independently, and can say what they learned from you.
* Quality standards in the squad are visibly higher: code review on all merge requests, no direct-to-prod, acceptance criteria per ticket — real, not aspirational.
**Why this role exists now**
Audit & Visibility is becoming a standalone product and the product surface is where its value is either visible or invisible to a customer. The Staff Engineer holds the backend and leads the squad; they cannot also be the only person setting the approach on the product side. We are shifting from feature-driven engineering to agent-led product architecture, and this is one of the surfaces where that shift has to actually land.
## Additional Information
You'll need to be based in either the UK or the Netherlands - we're a remote team with clusters of people in London and Amsterdam.

By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

IFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend, and automate execution. The product began as 7bridges and is now part of IFS, with a small, focused team working closely with the commercial organisation.
We build SaaS products that customers can run themselves. The platform handles busy, data-heavy logistics operations, so reliability and clear operational visibility matter every day.
**The role**
You will join Diego Silva, our Lead DevOps Engineer, as the second DevOps specialist responsible for the platform. You will take ownership of substantial workstreams while partnering closely with application and data engineers.
There is useful work to do from day one. We want every merge request reviewed, production deployments controlled, and releases running to a predictable cadence. Those practices are not yet consistent across the team. Our monitoring also needs to cover more of the application and data estate, and our pipelines need stronger detection, recovery and ownership when something fails.

* Experience operating data pipelines, such as streaming ingestion, warehouse loads, dbt transformations or similar workflows.
* The confidence to challenge an unsafe change and explain what needs to happen before it can ship.
* Practical experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude, including how you provide context and verify infrastructure changes before accepting them.

* Security or compliance work in an enterprise SaaS environment.
* Experience designing incident-management or on-call processes.
* BigQuery cost and performance tuning.

The team is growing and the platform needs to support a faster pace of delivery. That requires better visibility, stronger data pipelines and release controls that work without relying on individual memory or manual intervention.

As AI becomes increasingly central to the future of legal services, Linklaters is investing significantly in technology, data and applied intelligence. The role will also provide exposure to the continued development of Linklaters' Applied Intelligence practice and its client-facing strategy.
This is an opportunity to work at the centre of a fast-evolving area, where the technology, operating model and ways of working continue to develop. You will need to be comfortable operating without an established playbook and excited by the opportunity to learn quickly, adapt and help turn an ambitious agenda into tangible outcomes.

# Staff Supplier Quality Engineer
Oxford, England, United Kingdom
**About IonQ:**
IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance. Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.
**Location:** Oxford, UK **Office commitment:** Hybrid
**The Role:**
Quantum is now, and it's built here. Oxford Ionics, now part of IonQ, is pioneering the next generation of quantum computing. Using our world-leading trapped-ion technology, we're building the most powerful, accurate and reliable quantum systems to tackle problems that today's supercomputers cannot solve.
We are looking for a hands-on Staff Supplier Quality Engineer to join a cross-functional team building the world's best quantum computers. You will make sure the components and materials coming from our supply base meet the reliability and performance our systems depend on.
Working with manufacturing, supply chain and design engineering, you will create and maintain the quality systems and processes that govern our external suppliers. Supplier quality is paramount at IonQ, and this role brings a systematic approach to putting a robust Quality Management System in place, running it and maintaining it across the supply base. 25-50% of this role involves travel, mainly for supplier visits and audits.
**Responsibilities**:
You will own supplier quality from selection and qualification through to ongoing performance. That means working with Strategic Sourcing and Engineering & Technology to audit and assess potential suppliers, and owning incoming material inspection, first article inspection and source release decisions. Where no industry standard exists for a novel component, you will define how it is qualified and inspected.
You will also be the supplier quality voice in the company's governance. You will lead the supplier quality position at the Qualification Review Board, represent Supplier Quality on the Change Control Board and contribute to the disposition of nonconforming material at the Material Review Board. You will report supplier quality performance to management and show how it supports IonQ's objectives.
Key responsibilities include:
* Leading supplier selection, qualification, audits and assessments, and driving continuous improvement at supplier sites
* Owning the Approved Supplier List, including the decision authority for supplier approval, conditional approval and disapproval
* Running the Supplier Corrective Action Request process, leading containment, root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action through to closure
* Setting and driving supplier quality KPIs, and presenting performance at management review
* Flowing customer and federal programme requirements ECJU, UK Dual-Use List, DEFCON and DCC and Cyber Essentials) down to suppliers and verifying compliance, and contributing to the supplier quality roadmap for new product introduction
**Requirements:**
You will bring around eight years or more of supplier quality, manufacturing or manufacturing engineering experience in a production environment, along with a degree in engineering or another technical discipline. You will have extensive experience of supplier failure analysis, root cause analysis and corrective action, and of putting robust process controls in place across a supply chain. You weigh several sources of data and alternative solutions before committing to a path.
You will know Quality Management Systems such as AS9100 and the ISO quality management standard, quality tools such as Six Sigma and 8D, and ERP and MRP systems, ideally Oracle NetSuite. You communicate clearly with suppliers, senior management and non-technical colleagues, and you work self-directed, setting your own approach on new assignments and managing several priorities in a fast-paced environment.
You’d be a great fit with:
* Experience thriving in a rapidly changing, fast-scaling start-up environment
* Working knowledge of industry standards such as ANSI, ASTM, AS9100 and AS9102, and of ECJU, UK Dual-Use List, DEFCON and DCC and Cyber Essentials requirements as they apply to suppliers
* Experience with complex optical, electrical or mechanical products in high-technology manufacturing
* Working knowledge of reliability engineering, ESD, calibration and preventive maintenance in a supplier context
* Experience leading cross-functional and supplier teams through systematic improvement, including compliance data collection and sharing with tools such as Power BI
* Experience and knowledge of environmental, health & safety management systems, such as ISO 14001, and achieving business certifications.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, particularly in interacting with external suppliers and senior management, including the ability to explain data requirements to both technical and non-technical audiences.
**Benefits**
Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.
We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.
Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.

You will make sure that incoming, in-process and finished components meet their mechanical, electrical and PCBA specifications. You will also own the inspection side of the Material Review Board process, from handling and containing nonconforming material, through the inspection actions the board assigns, to verifying, closing and tracking nonconformance records once the Quality Engineer has given the disposition. As the senior technical resource for inspection, you will allocate the daily inspection work and guide less experienced inspectors. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with the integrity to hold quality standards under production pressure.
**Responsibilities**:
Day to day, you will inspect incoming parts, in-process production and finished goods against approved specifications, drawings and purchase order requirements, deciding the inspection method and sequence with little instruction. You will interpret drawing callouts and datum structures to GD&T and ASME Y14.5, turn them into inspection plans and acceptance criteria, apply statistical sampling plans and use the right metrology instruments, including programming and running CMM, OMM or vision systems. You will support the calibration schedule, remove out of tolerance equipment from service and keep the inspection area to the local 5S procedure.
When something is wrong, you will control it. You will identify, tag, segregate and quarantine nonconforming material with correct lot and serial traceability to ISO 9001 and AS9100, sweep stock and work in progress to contain every affected lot, write the nonconformance record and present the inspection evidence at the Material Review Board. You will carry out the actions the board assigns, verify scrap disposal so nothing returns to the supply chain, and feed inspection data to the Quality Engineer for root cause analysis and supplier corrective action. You will also support internal, customer and regulatory audits, and keep to the quality management system, export control and customer contract requirements for controlled material and data.

# Research Lead / Senior Scientist (DMPK), London
London
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.
Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.
### **About Iso**
Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
### **Your impact**
At Isomorphic Labs, DMPK Leads drive the DMPK strategy of drug discovery projects to deliver high quality clinical candidates whilst using and contributing to the optimisation of state-of-the-art computational and AI ADME models.
As part of the Drug Design and Medical Research team and through close collaboration with the Technology teams, you will be supporting the business alongside world leading AI/ML Drug Design Platform teams. You will collaborate to deliver scientific expertise and strategic direction to drive both improvements in the Platform and apply this to real drug design projects.
If you are a skilled and ambitious scientist looking to take the next step in your career, joining Isomorphic Labs will lift you out of your comfort zone and provide you with an amazing opportunity for personal growth and development.
* Experience with biologics, peptides and other new modalities.
* Define and implement stage-appropriate DMPK and ADME strategies across multiple modalities
* Utilise state-of-the-art modelling (e.g., ML/AI and PBPK) to extrapolate preclinical data and predict human dosing, efficacy, and safety windows
* Experienced author and reviewer of DMPK regulatory documents and experience in responding to regulatory queries
### **What you will do**
* Design and implement stage-appropriate DMPK strategies with AI-first approach, integrating quantitative pharmacology and overall project strategies.
* Design screening cascade and mechanistic experiments to support project progression in a data-driven manner.
* Integrate DMPK, PD and toxicological data to extract decision-making information, including dose and safety window predictions.
* Define Quantitative Pharmacology strategy in collaboration with Pharmacology Leads.
* Optimise the use of Iso’s datasets to address fundamental DMPK questions and advance the field.
* Optimise molecule design based on physico-chemistry and biotransformation knowledge in collaboration with Chemistry Leads.
* Maintain knowledge of state-of-the-art technologies and methods to increase confidence in human PK prediction.
* Author DMPK sections of regulatory documents.
* Embrace and champion a culture of inclusion and continuous professional development.
### **Skills and qualifications**
#### **Essential:**
* PhD in either Pharmaceutical Science, Pharmacy, Chemistry, or another relevant subject.
* 8+ years’ professional experience as a DMPK Lead, solving DMPK-related problems in drug discovery with a track record of working collaboratively to deliver high quality candidates.
* Experience in supporting DMPK across multiple modalities.
* Comprehensive understanding of drug metabolism, pharmacokinetics, PKPD principles, and translational research.
* Practical experience developing DMPK and quantitative pharmacology packages to support early clinical development, including authoring and reviewing regulatory documents, ideally in oncology or immunology.
* Experience of partnering closely with Preclinical and Clinical teams.
* Demonstrated cross-functional leadership and exceptional interpersonal, communication, and collaborative problem-solving capabilities.
* In depth knowledge of biotransformation.
* Experience of utilising and applying NAMs to further project understanding
* Strategic thinker with strong communication skills, capable of working across multiple disciplines
#### **Nice to have:**
* Advanced knowledge of PKPD modelling.
* Good understanding of machine learning techniques.
* Familiarity with R, Python and KNIME.
### **Culture and values**
We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.
**Thoughtful**Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.
**Brave**Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.
**Determined**Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.
**Together**Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.

It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. # Talent Partner - First Opinion
**Remote | Covering the North of England**

## ## About Us
At Inspiring Vet Care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK's leading veterinary care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals and united by a shared purpose: healthier animals and happier owners.
We're looking for a talented and relationship-focused Talent Partner to support our First Opinion network, identifying and engaging exceptional veterinary professionals within one of the most specialist and talent-scarce markets in the UK.
This is far more than a traditional recruitment role. Success will come from your ability to understand specialist talent markets, build meaningful relationships with candidates who may not be actively seeking a move, and influence hiring decisions through insight, research and market expertise.
Blending headhunting, executive search principles, talent mapping and workforce planning, you'll partner closely with clinical leaders to deliver both immediate hiring needs and long-term talent strategies that support the future growth of our network.
This is a fully remote, home-based position covering the North of England. Occasional travel will be required for meetings, veterinary congresses and industry events across the UK and Europe.
## How You'll Make a Difference
As a trusted Talent Partner, you'll take ownership of recruitment across a portfolio of First Opinion vacancies, partnering with senior clinical and commercial stakeholders to attract and secure outstanding talent.
A key part of your success will be developing a deep understanding of the clinical disciplines you support and the talent markets they operate within. You'll use these insights to shape recruitment strategies, advise on market conditions and influence decisions around attraction, compensation, relocation and international hiring.
You'll proactively identify and engage specialist veterinary professionals through market mapping, targeted search activity and long-term relationship building, creating sustainable talent pipelines that extend beyond immediate vacancies.
### You'll also:
* Lead proactive search and headhunting strategies to identify and engage high-calibre talent across the UK and internationally.
* Build and nurture long-term relationships with veterinary professionals, creating talent communities across priority disciplines.
* Partner with senior leaders to provide recruitment market insights and influence hiring strategies.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment processes, including sourcing, assessment, offer negotiation, relocation and visa sponsorship where applicable.
* Represent Inspiring Vet Care at industry events, veterinary congresses and networking opportunities across the UK and Europe.
* Use recruitment data, talent intelligence and market trends to continuously improve hiring outcomes and strengthen direct sourcing capability.
## ## You Might Be a Great Fit If...
You may already be working within an in-house recruitment or talent acquisition environment and are looking for the next step in your career. You're excited by the opportunity to move beyond transactional recruitment and into a more strategic, delivery-focused role where you can genuinely influence hiring outcomes and talent strategy.
You bring energy, curiosity and fresh ideas, alongside a passion for building relationships and uncovering talent others may not find. You're motivated by continuous improvement and enjoy finding new and innovative ways to attract, engage and assess candidates.
You're skilled at looking beyond the active candidate market, understanding where specialist talent sits and building credibility with individuals whose career decisions may evolve over months or even years.
You enjoy becoming an expert in the markets you support, using insights, data and research to influence hiring decisions and advise stakeholders with confidence.
You quickly establish trust with both candidates and hiring managers and are comfortable providing informed recommendations, challenging assumptions and helping stakeholders navigate complex hiring decisions.
Most importantly, you recognise that exceptional hiring is built on long-term relationships. You're motivated by creating sustainable talent pipelines, delivering outstanding candidate experiences and making a meaningful impact on the business areas you support.
Previous veterinary recruitment experience would be beneficial, but it isn't essential. What's most important is your ability to apply proactive search methodologies, develop expertise within specialist talent markets and operate as a credible and trusted recruitment partner.
## You'll Bring
* Expertise in headhunting, talent mapping and proactive sourcing within specialist or difficult-to-fill markets.
* Experience engaging and influencing passive candidates through relationship-led recruitment approaches.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and challenge constructively.
* Excellent candidate assessment, negotiation and closing skills.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to translate market intelligence into effective recruitment strategies.
* Outstanding communication, networking and relationship-building skills.
* A proactive, resilient and collaborative mindset.
* Experience within veterinary, healthcare or another specialist professional market would be advantageous, as would exposure to international recruitment, relocation and visa sponsorship.

At Inspiring Vet Care, we're committed to helping our people thrive.
You'll join an experienced Talent team and work alongside knowledgeable clinical leaders who are passionate about the profession and the people within it. We'll support you in developing a deep understanding of the veterinary sector, specialist career pathways and the talent communities you'll recruit within.
You'll have the autonomy to build specialist networks, shape sourcing strategies and establish your own presence within the industry. You'll also have opportunities to attend leading veterinary congresses and professional events across the UK and Europe.

Director – Real Estate Management Services (REMS) Data & Intelligence
Research Innovation is one of JLL Research's platform teams, built to turn our data, machine learning, AI, and insights capabilities into a competitive advantage.
This role is responsible for working with the REMS business, REMS Research leaders, and REMS technology teams to prioritize, source, and make actionable the data that generates the greatest opportunity for insight — including facilities and property management data, occupancy planning data, portfolio data, and development cost and trend data, drawn from one of the world's largest real estate occupier services companies. From there, the role works across the full Research organization — property sector and industry teams, other business line teams, and local market teams — to ensure that data gets used and folded into insights broadly, not just within REMS.
The Research Innovation Team is looking for a Director with real estate data experience to help us turn that untapped opportunity into usable, trusted tools. This role focuses on data stewardship, integration, and analysis — ensuring the tools and platforms we build for Research stay aligned with what teams and clients actually need. Reports to the Global Director for Capital Markets & REMS Data & Intelligence.
Key Responsibilities
Data discovery & prioritization: Work with the REMS business, REMS Research leaders, and REMS technology teams to identify and evaluate major datasets; prioritize what to source and integrate first based on insight potential
Data stewardship: Act as data custodian — maintain a dataset inventory, know where data lives, and ensure proper governance
Alignment & deduplication: Reconcile overlapping or conflicting data across sources — for example, where two teams hold similar data under different definitions, or where survey instruments and operational data tell overlapping stories — so Research works from a single, trusted version
Data validation & enrichment: Build workflows that validate and enrich data coming from source systems, so Research experts can trust they're working with the highest-quality data available
Market insights: Track how other firms are using comparable data to inform our approach
Cross-functional partnership: Manage a range of stakeholders — REMS Research leadership, REMS business leaders, and REMS data and technology teams — to source and make data actionable, then work across property sector, industry, business line, and local market teams to ensure it's adopted and used research-wide
Tooling & product alignment: Partner with Research Innovation and technology teams to ensure platforms and tools reflect Research's priorities and real-world data needs — not building wholesale products, but keeping them aligned to what the data and business require
AI-augmented insights: Spot opportunities to apply data science and machine learning to strengthen research and decision-making, including building agentic AI tools that automate data workflows and surface insights faster
Enabling storytelling: Partner closely with the researchers and analysts building stories from the data, making sure they get the underlying data and intelligence in the form and detail they need — rather than telling those stories directly

Experience building data validation and enrichment workflows to ensure high-quality data from source systems

Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their business application

Legal Engineer selling AI-powered legal solutions to law firms and in-house counsel, combining legal expertise with sales and customer education

mid · 3+ yrs

THE ROLE
WHY HARVEY
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
ROLE OVERVIEW
Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.
Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.
Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

* Engage with lawyers at existing and prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges, and then explain and demonstrate the value of Harvey’s AI solutions to address them.
* Establish yourself as a credible expert in solving customers’ specific legal problems (e.g. researching public and private databases for certain types of information, drafting and analyzing contractual provisions and whole documents, analyzing briefs and filings, corporate governance, conducting due diligence).
* Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.
* Partner with the marketing team to develop content that will resonate with lawyers, tailored to the unique needs of their practice areas and client types.
* Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.
* Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs.
* Further the market perception of Harvey as uniquely credible, substantive, and helpful in applying its AI solutions to make lawyers better at their jobs.
* Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors.
* Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.
WHAT YOU HAVE
* Must be qualified to practice law in England & Wales, with at least 3 PQE at a top-tier law firm in the U.K within a funds practice.
* Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels
* Outstanding presentation skills to both legal and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Strong understanding of legal processes and challenges faced by legal professionals.
* Curiosity about AI’s potential to transform the legal industry.
* Sales or customer-facing experience, including law firm business development and/or secondment, is a plus, as is experience directly managing law firm client matters and client relationships.

OverviewApplication
## About Kernel
Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?
Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.
Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.
Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at **Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion** already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.
We have raised **$20M** from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing **12x YoY**.
## The Role
We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.
This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.
You'll also be **Kernel's own internal customer**, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.
You'll report to **Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations**, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.
## What You'll Be Doing
* **Build a better outbound engine:** improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time
* **Make the GTM team more productive:** automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers
* **Run the revenue operating infrastructure:** own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion
* **Set the rules of engagement:** own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person
* **Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel:** build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible
* **Be Kernel's own internal customer:** deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

* **Deep Salesforce fluency:** you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior
* **Strong GTM building ability:** you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt
* **Commercial judgment:** you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention
* **Strong data instincts:** you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time
* **Clear, low-ego communication:** you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?
Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. # **Senior Engineer (Ingestion)**
TypeScript, Node.js, ClickHouse, Event-Driven Data Pipelines
## **Why join Levellr**
Levellr is the enterprise community intelligence platform for Discord, Reddit and a growing range of community platforms, trusted by major gaming companies like Scopely, Krafton, and Epic, alongside global brands such as Google, YouTube, and SoundCloud to grow and monetise their communities.
With millions of messages generated, turning raw activity into clear insight is difficult. Levellr helps teams understand members, spot trends, improve engagement, and make data-driven commercial decisions.
This depends on reliable data ingestion. Our dashboards, reporting, and AI tools require timely, accurate data processing. As we expand customers and sources, ingestion sits at the core of our platform growth.
## **What you'll work on**
You'll join our ingestion squad as a Senior Engineer owning end-to-end data collection, processing, and storage across our integrations.
As we transition to an event-driven architecture, you will design event flows, queuing, retries, failure recovery, and data consistency at scale.
Handling millions of messages, you'll focus on throughput, latency, deduplication, backfills, schema design, and data-store performance while building pipeline observability.
Collaborating with product and AI teams, you'll identify pipeline bottlenecks and deliver continuous incremental updates in ambiguous problem spaces.
You’ll also help us add new platforms fast (Discord, Reddit, Steam, X and customers’ own sources), building the system that makes each new integration quick and cheap, increasingly with AI agents doing the build.
## **How we ship**
Levellr has a strong bias towards shipping and learning from production. We ship early, iterate rapidly, and learn from production. Core systems like Levellr AI moved from initial concept to shipped foundations in weeks.
For ingestion, this pace requires care. Our transition to event-driven architectures must be incremental to ensure continuous data flow.
This demands strong engineering judgement—knowing when to simplify, invest in core foundations, refactor, or adjust approaches quickly.
## **The level we're looking for**
We need a hands-on Senior Engineer who has owned high-volume production data pipelines and can take immediate system ownership.
You can detail past systems you owned, including throughput volume, load patterns, performance bottlenecks, and structural optimizations.
Production experience with messaging queues, pub/sub, or streams is essential, alongside understanding ordering, idempotency, retries, and dead-letter handling.
You proactively address risks, communicate technical trade-offs, and take accountability for operational health in production.
## **What good looks like in you**
* Solid backend engineering experience with significant focus on data pipelines and infrastructure.
* Proficiency with TypeScript and Node.js across backend services and database stores.
* AI-native engineering day to day: you build with coding agents and know where they help and where they bite.
* Strong data-store skills at scale (schema design, query optimisation, indexing, partitioning), ideally across both relational and analytical stores such as ClickHouse.
* Hands-on ownership of ingestion edge cases: rate limits, schema drifts, backfills, and partial failures.
* Focus on pipeline observability, monitoring data freshness, and maintaining strict data quality standards.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, establish technical clarity, and drive progress independently.
* Preference for incremental delivery based on real-world usage rather than lengthy isolated development cycles.
* Clear communication through concise PRs, technical docs, and async updates that elevate team performance.
* Located in European timezones with core overlap with UK business hours.
## **This role probably isn't right if**
* Your experience centers primarily on standard SaaS features without backend data complexity.
* Your core focus is building AI applications rather than underlying data ingestion systems.
* You haven't directly owned high-volume data pipelines in production environments.
* You haven't worked with data at a scale where schema design, indexing and query optimisation really mattered.
* You require extensive pre-defined structure to operate and deliver.
* You prefer extended planning cycles or total rewrites over continuous production deployment.
* You struggle making quick technical trade-offs under dynamic conditions.
## **The tools we use**
* TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS and React across the product.
* PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redis and PubSub across data, analytics and messaging.
* Google Cloud, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions and Cloudflare for infrastructure and delivery.
* Google Agent Platform (Vertex AI), OpenAI, Anthropic and other LLM platforms across our AI systems.
## **Nice to have**
* Experience with GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, or equivalent event-streaming technologies.
* Familiarity with Temporal or other durable execution frameworks.
* Hands-on work with third-party platform APIs, handling rate limits and dynamic payloads.
* Direct experience managing Discord, Reddit, or social media datasets.
* Exposure to how ingested data feeds downstream AI or search systems.
* Background in high-growth startup environments driving fast-paced technical decisions.
* Experience migrating live systems toward event-driven architectures without service interruption.
* Track record of impactful technical writing, open-source projects, or engineering documentation.
## Who we are
Levellr was founded by Tom (CEO) and Ben (CTO), who have experience in both start-ups and large scale companies (YouTube, Eleven Sports). Since 2021 we’ve grown the team to 30+ employees and are backed by a number of successful angels (Mark Pincus, Dylan Collins, Mitch Lasky, Bing Gordon, Frank Gibeau to name a few). The product that we are building is growing in multiple verticals, seeing a 6x growth over the last 3 years and on track to continue.
We believe in substance over hype. We're a product-led company building a sustainable business by solving our customers' most pressing problems. This allows us to create a culture and a company that we're proud to build together. Some of the values we stand for:
We have ownership. We embrace change and take bold risks.
We get shit done. We have a bias for action and love creating value from our code and our conversations.
We disagree and commit. We give radically honest feedback and challenge assumptions, then get behind the result & move on.
We grow in uncertainty. We embrace change, learn from feedback, and continuously improve what we do for our customers.
We care. We care about our team, our customers, and the communities we serve.

## Your Mission
The Role / Role Scope.
Linnworks is a fast-growing, international SaaS scale-up, selling to ecommerce brands and retailers across the UK, Europe and North America. Our BDR team is the front door to our pipeline: every inbound demo request and every outbound conversation starts with them.
We are looking for a BDR Manager, based in the UK with a global remit, to lead that team and make it the most effective, AI-powered top-of-funnel function in our market. You'll manage inbound and outbound BDRs across the UK and US, partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Partners and RevOps, and own the targets that feed our Account Executives.
The traditional SDR model of high-volume activity and generic sequences is breaking. This is not a role for someone who wants to run the playbook they ran last time. You'll be the one who rewrites it: redesigning how our BDRs research, prioritise, personalise and convert, so a small, sharp team generates outsized pipeline across two regions.
Responsibilities.
### Lead and Develop a Global Team
You won't just manage activity; you'll build careers. You'll lead inbound and outbound BDRs across the UK and US and turn them into the next generation of Account Executives.
* Hire and Onboard: Recruit, ramp and retain top BDR talent across both regions, with a structured onboarding plan that gets new hires productive fast.
* Coach to a Standard: Run weekly 1:1s, call reviews and skills sessions focused on discovery, objection handling and written outreach.
* One Team, Two Time Zones: Build a consistent culture and operating rhythm across the UK and US, with fair coverage of both markets.
### Make AI the Engine, Not an Add-On
You'll set the bar for how AI is used across our top of funnel, and lead by example.
* Design AI-First Workflows: Embed AI into account research, prioritisation, personalisation, call summaries and follow-up so BDRs spend more time in real conversations.
* Build the Toolkit: Develop and maintain shared prompts, agents and playbooks; test new AI sales tools and decide what earns a place in the stack.
* Raise Capability: Coach every BDR to use AI confidently and well, without letting outreach become generic.
* Measure the Impact: Track what AI changes in speed-to-lead, conversion and output per head, and share what works.
### Own Pipeline Generation
You are accountable for the number. Inbound and outbound both report to you, so you'll balance speed on inbound with precision on outbound.
* Inbound: Own speed-to-lead, qualification standards and handoff quality
* Outbound: Shape territory, account selection and multi-threaded sequences against our ICP in the UK and US.
* Forecast and Report: Set targets, forecast meetings and pipeline, and report performance to Sales and Revenue leadership.
### Improve the GTM Engine
You'll look beyond your own team to make the whole funnel work better.
* Partner with Marketing: Feed back on lead quality, messaging and what prospects are asking about; co-own lead scoring and SLAs.
* Partner with Sales: Agree what a qualified meeting looks like and keep the BDR-to-AE handoff tight.
* Partner with RevOps: Keep CRM and sales engagement data clean, and improve routing, dashboards and process.
* Experiment: Run structured tests on channels, messaging and plays, then scale what wins.
### Your Team
You'll lead a mixed inbound and outbound team across two regions, reporting into Sales leadership.
## What You'll Bring To The Role
Experience
* 2+ years leading SDR/BDR teams in B2B SaaS, with a track record of hitting or beating pipeline targets.
* Experience managing both inbound and outbound motions, ideally across more than one region or time zone.
* A history of hiring, coaching and promoting BDRs into AE or senior roles.
* Hands-on experience as a high-performing BDR or SDR yourself.
* Deep familiarity with CRM and sales engagement tools (HubSpot or Salesforce; Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo or similar).
* Bonus: experience selling to ecommerce brands or knowledge of platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce or Amazon.
Skills & Attributes
* AI-Native: You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or AI sales platforms every day, have rolled AI workflows out to a team, and can show the results.
* Forward-Thinking: You spot where the GTM motion is heading and act before the market forces it.
* A Coach First: You get energy from developing people and hold a high bar with empathy.
* Data-Driven: You don't just report on conversion; you explain why it moved and what you'll change.
* Commercially Sharp: You understand how BDR activity turns into revenue and can talk credibly with Sales, Marketing and leadership.
* Clear Communicator: Excellent written and verbal English, comfortable leading across UK and US working styles.
## Why us?
## What Success Looks Like
* First 30 Days: You know every BDR, the funnel data and the stack. You've shadowed calls in both regions and mapped where time and pipeline are lost.
* By 90 Days: You've shipped a refreshed AI-enabled workflow, set clear targets and SLAs with Marketing and Sales, and built a reporting rhythm leadership trusts.
* By 12 Months: The team consistently hits its pipeline targets, output per BDR is measurably higher, and at least one BDR has been promoted.
You'll be measured on qualified meetings and pipeline generated, meeting-to-opportunity conversion, speed-to-lead on inbound, ramp time for new hires, and team retention and progression.
## The Reality of the Role
To be transparent, this isn't a "maintenance" role.
* The Pace: We move fast. You'll need to be comfortable with 80% certainty and 100% action.
* The Ambiguity: AI tooling changes monthly. You'll be writing the playbook while we're playing the game.
* The Hours: Leading a UK and US team means regular late-afternoon and early-evening overlap with US colleagues.

# Consultants - City Bridge Trust
Consultants sought to support the strategic development of place-based giving schemes in London. Your work will help us explore the feasibility of extending our work in this area to a new level.
Timetable:
- The closing date for applications is 5pm Monday 25th April 2022.
- Interviews will take place on Thursday 5th May 2022.
- We hope the work can commence soon after this date. The work will kick-off with an inception meeting with representatives from the Task & Finish Group.
## About the roles
We have two briefs, outlined below. We expect one brief to take approximately 10-15 days, and the other to take approximately 10 days. Applicants can apply for one or both of the briefs.
### Part One: Resource Hub
**Purpose**
Building on the existing work of London’s Giving, the purpose is to scope the feasibility of establishing a Resource Hub which would take this programme to a new level.
We are open-minded as to what we mean by Resource Hub and this is part of the purpose of this consultancy. As well as the existing work of the London’s Giving programme, we know there are other potential resources but they are not well-signposted.
A Resource Hub could include, but would not be limited to, access to freelance support; database advice; marketing; signposting; and/or building the existing London’s Giving Network to create a Community of Practice.
Should the establishment of a Resource Hub be considered both feasible and desirable, the study should also set out best options for where it should be located – whether virtually or physically.
**Tasks**
* Close liaison with the Consultant engaged to work on Part Two to ensure that both concepts are aligned and complementary.
* Scoping and mapping what resources are already in place, both internally and externally, and how to better utilise them, including how to maintain their dynamism and relevance.
* Consultation with London Funders regarding existing resources for London’s Giving and the potential to build on these.
* Consultation with City Bridge Trust on its vision for the future of London’s Giving.
* Consultation with the London’s Giving network to establish what PBGS would like to see in place by way of a Resource Hub. Probably by way of a questionnaire, followed by targeted 1:1 meetings.
* Desk research into external resources available, for example, (but not limited to) the Institute of Fundraising, social media fundraising groups.
* Desk research into potential funders for the resource.
* What the cost will be and options for the future sustainability of such a resource.
* Options for the location of the resource, how it builds on the existing programme of London’s Giving and how it interacts with existing infrastructure and resources on place-based giving.
* Options for how to operationalise the resource with maximum effectiveness and efficiency, including how to ensure it remains fresh, up-to-date and relevant.
* Consultation with stakeholders on the likely recommendations on completion of this brief.
**Outputs**
* A final report with recommendations for the way forward and next steps: including options on the location of the resource; its resourcing and how to operationalise it. The report will need to be clear on how the recommendations tie in with our values and our diversity, equity and inclusion statement.
**Duration**
* We believe that the brief can be completed over a period of 10 – 15 working days.
### Part two: Establishment of a fund
**Purpose**
The purpose is to scope out the feasibility of establishing a fund that would act as match funding for PBGS which are aiming to secure funds from other donors. Also to research options on its size (critical mass), the broad parameters of a fund and the optimal home for a fund.
**Tasks**
* Close liaison with the Consultant engaged to work on Part One to ensure that both concepts are aligned and complementary.
* Consultation with PBGS on their vision for the purpose of a fund.
* Consultation with City Bridge Trust on likely available funding.
* Desk research into similar match-funding ‘pots’.
* Consultation with other potential donors to the fund (a clear steer will be given on who to contact).
**Outputs**
* Final report with clear recommendations as to the feasibility of establishing a fund and its optimal size. Options for where the fund should be located and options for engaging other donors. The report will need to be clear on how the recommendations tie in with our values and our diversity, equity and inclusion statement.
**Duration**
* We believe the brief can be completed within 10 working days.

## Job Description
**Job Purpose:**
This is an opportunity to join a growing international group and work at the centre of a diverse range of commercial and operational matters. Reporting to the Lucy Group Head of Legal, you will be a trusted first point of contact for allocated businesses and Group functions, providing clear, practical and commercially focused advice that helps colleagues make informed decisions and deliver their objectives. You will take ownership of routine and lower-risk matters, including contracts, tenders, compliance and day-to-day business issues, working with appropriate independence within established Group policies, precedents, delegated authorities and risk parameters. Supported by the Group Head of Legal and senior colleagues on material, complex or unusual matters, you will build broad technical, commercial and organisational experience and have a clear opportunity to develop your career within the Group Legal team.
**Business Overview:**
Lucy Group is a multinational private company based in Oxford, UK. Through our various businesses, we’re on a mission to enable the global shift to electrification and make the built environment sustainable. With around 1800 people across five continents and a turnover exceeding £400m, we’re growing rapidly, both organically and through acquisition.
**Job Context:**
The Legal Counsel provides practical, commercially focused legal support to Lucy Group businesses and Group functions across a broad range of commercial, corporate and operational matters. The role is responsible for reviewing, drafting and negotiating contracts, advising on legal and compliance risks, and supporting effective business decision-making within established risk frameworks. Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation, the role manages legal matters through to completion, escalates higher-risk issues as appropriate, and contributes to corporate governance, compliance initiatives and strategic projects while supporting senior members of the Legal Department on complex matters.
**Job Dimensions:**
This role operates within a flexible hybrid working model. The successful candidate will be expected to attend the Lucy Group Head Office in Oxford and other UK business locations as required, with a minimum office presence of three days per week. Attendance on the Legal Department's designated core office day (currently Thursday) is mandatory, while the remaining office-based days will be determined by operational and business requirements rather than a fixed working pattern. Travel between UK locations may be required to support business and stakeholder needs.
**Key Accountabilities:**
* Act as a first-line legal adviser on routine commercial, corporate and operational matters for allocated Lucy Group businesses and Group functions.
* Review, draft and negotiate standard customer, supplier, confidentiality, and other commercial agreements within established Group positions and risk parameters.
* Support sales and procurement teams on tenders and day-to-day contractual matters, identifying key legal and commercial risks and proposing practical mitigations.
* Advise on matters including data privacy, intellectual property, licensing, compliance and disputes, with senior guidance where the matter is material, complex or outside established parameters.
* Manage an allocated workload and take ownership of matters through to completion, maintaining clear records and providing timely updates to relevant stakeholders.
* Recognise and escalate material, unusual or higher risk matters promptly to the Group Head of Legal or another senior member of the Legal Department.
* Build effective working relationships with sales, procurement, finance, operational and functional teams and develop a sound understanding of the businesses supported.
* Support corporate governance, legal policies, compliance processes, training and other Group Legal initiatives as required.
* Assist senior Legal Department members on significant transactions, disputes, projects and other complex matters.
* With supervision, instruct and manage external legal counsel where required, ensuring that advice is timely, commercially focused, cost-effective and delivered within agreed budgetary constraints.
**Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience**
* Must be a UK-qualified solicitor or barrister, or hold an equivalent common-law qualification, with around three years’ post-qualification experience.
* Sound grounding in commercial contract law, with the ability to review, structure, draft and negotiate clear and practical contractual terms.
* Ability to identify legal and commercial risk, distinguish routine matters from those requiring escalation, and exercise sound judgement within agreed authority and supervision arrangements.
* Ability to manage a varied workload, meet deadlines and respond effectively as priorities change in a fast-paced international business.
* Ability to communicate legal issues, risk and recommended actions clearly and concisely to non-lawyers.
* Knowledge of laws and regulations relevant to Lucy Group businesses, such as international trade, data privacy and security, electricity distribution and technology licensing, would be advantageous.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled legal tools, provided that is combined with independent judgement, the ability to work from first principles and appropriate management of confidentiality, accuracy and legal risk.
**Behavioural Competencies**
* A proactive, can-do approach, with a focus on providing responsive and commercially useful service to internal clients across the Group.
* Strong time-management and prioritisation skills, with a reliable and timely approach to delivery.
* Collaborative teamworking and influencing skills, with openness to guidance, feedback and continuous development.
* Acts with integrity and consistently demonstrates Lucy Group values.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with a personable and professional approach.
* Ability to build credibility and work effectively with colleagues and business partners at different levels, while recognising when senior legal involvement is required.

## Description
Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium and luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.
At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search and discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfilment, and personalisation. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and we use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better decisions and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.
**Role**
Product data, and the systems used to transform and enrich it, sit at the heart of how Lyst serves customers and grows revenue. We are looking for a technically strong Product Manager to lead the direction and delivery of the platforms that support our affiliate operations, paid marketing and product-data enrichment.
You will work across two connected missions. The first is helping our commercial teams launch and improve high-value capabilities such as channel integrations, product feeds, conversion and cost data, attribution, reporting and ROAS optimisation. The second is improving the quality, reliability and discoverability of Lyst's product catalogue through internal tooling, product data enrichment, merging and deduplication, leveraging our partnership with our Data Science team in New Zealand.
This is not a conventional consumer-facing Product Manager role. Many requests will arrive with a clear commercial goal and a proposed solution. Your job is to use judgement: move quickly when the problem and solution are well understood; challenge, simplify or productise the request when that will create more value; and make the trade-offs visible when BAU, reliability, technical debt and roadmap work compete for the same capacity.
**What you'll do**

* Enough technical depth to work confidently with APIs, schemas, data contracts, ETL or ingestion pipelines, event flows and production systems.
